verses.text: From the elder, to the chosen lady and her children. I truly love you, and not only I, but also everyone who knows the truth loves you.
We love you because of the truth that lives in us and will be with us forever.
Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Father's Son, will be with us in truth and love.
I was very glad to find some of your children living in the truth, just as the Father commanded us.
And now, dear lady, I ask you that we love one another. This is not a new command I am writing to you. It is the one we have had from the beginning.
And this is love: that we live by obeying his commands. This is the command you heard from the beginning: that you live in love.
Many liars have gone out into the world. They do not say that Jesus Christ came as a real human being. Anyone like that is the liar and the Antichrist.
Watch out, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but receive your full reward.
Anyone who goes too far and does not stay in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Anyone who stays in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not take him into your house, and do not welcome him.
Anyone who welcomes him takes part in the evil things he does.
I have many things to write to you, but I do not want to use paper and ink. I hope to come to you and talk face to face, so that our joy can be full.
The children of your chosen sister send you their greetings. Amen.
